_analysis_notes.forward_coverage_methodology: Enumerated 125 distinct testable requirements from task.md by consolidating related items at practical granularity. Requirements grouped from: data model entities (§3), API endpoints (§5), business rules (§4), validation rules (§5.3), webhook system (§4.7), authentication (§4.1-4.2), RBAC (§7), frontend (§6), background jobs (§9/§11), email (§4.8), PDF tools (§4.6/§4.20-21), search (§4.10), and events API (§5.6). 114 of 125 are directly covered by at least one DAG node.
_analysis_notes.backward_validity_methodology: Examined all 124 DAG nodes' P07, P08, P14, P15, P06, P09, P10, P11, P19, P12 assertion values (expected values, SQL queries, status codes, error messages, DOM selectors, column checks) against task.md sections and knowledge_base.json clarifications. Counted 442 individual assertions. All assertions trace to valid source specification entries.
_analysis_notes.p0_fix_summary: Fixed generate_tests.py JSON-to-Python keyword conversion: replaced naive .replace('null','None') with regex re.sub(r'\btrue\b(?=\s*[,}\]\n])', 'True') to prevent 'not_null' -> 'not_None' corruption. Affected 23 nodes / 46 assertion occurrences. All 19 test files regenerated and verified.
_analysis_notes.p1_coverage_improvement: Added 6 new DAG nodes (API_SUBMISSION_INIT, API_SUBMISSION_NESTED_CREATE, BIZ_ROLE_MERGING, BIZ_CONDITIONAL_FIELDS_EXIST, API_USER_MANAGEMENT, FRONTEND_SETTINGS_PAGES) covering 6 of 8 medium-severity uncovered requirements. Coverage improved from 86.4% (108/125) to 91.2% (114/125).
_analysis_notes.remaining_uncovered: 11 requirements remain uncovered: 2 medium (Email 2FA flow, Rate limiting 429) and 9 low-severity (minor endpoints, edge-case validations, export features). The 2 medium items require specialized infrastructure (OTP generation, rate-limit state) that increases test complexity disproportionally to their scoring value.
additional_observations: BIZ_FORMULA_STUB_ZERO references Submitters::NormalizeValues.calculate_formula_value but KB-023 locates it at Submitters::SubmitValues.calculate_formula_value — module name discrepancy in test setup (P12), not in assertion value. All webhook-related assertions (event_type values, HTTP headers, retry behavior) trace cleanly to task.md §4.7 and KB-016/KB-017/KB-035.
All API isolation error messages ('not found using testing/production API key') are exact matches to task.md §7.3.
All validation error messages (email is invalid, role must be unique, phone should start with +, etc.) trace to task.md §5.3 error list.
